requirements.title: Index any repository into structural chunks
requirements.description: Parse files with tree-sitter and chunk by function/class/method, falling back to a sliding window for unsupported files.
acceptance: Supported-language files produce one chunk per top-level symbol
Unsupported or unparseable files are still indexed via windowed chunks

requirements.title: Incremental and live re-indexing
requirements.description: Only changed chunks are re-embedded; moved code is fixed up by content hash; watch mode keeps the index live.
acceptance: Re-indexing an unchanged repo embeds nothing new
Watch mode picks up a file edit

requirements.title: Hybrid vector + BM25 + graph retrieval with RRF
requirements.description: Queries combine semantic, exact-identifier and code-graph signals fused by RRF, degrading to BM25+graph if the embedder fails.
acceptance: Identifier queries rank the exact symbol first
Plain-English queries return the relevant function
Embedder failure still returns BM25/graph results

requirements.title: Pluggable embedders
requirements.description: Mock (offline, deterministic), Voyage and Jina embedders behind one interface, with dims-consistency enforcement.
acceptance: Mock embedder works with no network or key
Switching dims without rebuild is rejected

requirements.title: Library, CLI and HTTP API surfaces
requirements.description: The same engine is exposed as a TypeScript library (ESM + CJS), a CLI (index/query/list/serve) and a Fastify HTTP API (index jobs, query, workspaces).
acceptance: Library importable via import and require
CLI commands work end to end
API endpoints respond per the README

requirements.title: Local-first, zero native compilation
requirements.description: Runs on Node >= 22.5 with WASM tree-sitter and node:sqlite; one portable SQLite file per workspace; no data leaves the machine unless a remote embedder is chosen.
acceptance: Fresh install builds with no native toolchain
Index is a single SQLite file per workspace

requirements.title: Local quality gates
requirements.description: Lint, typecheck, tests and build pass locally, since hosted CI is unavailable.
acceptance: pnpm lint, typecheck, test and build all pass on a clean checkout
